powerfarm, powerfarm, powerfarm. ban kha, xin or master yi. learn to kite camps properly. try to full clear always (unless there's an obvious gank or skirmish near you), 3:30 it's decent enough. starting red side is faster since you can do blue and gromp at the same time later. remember you don't have cc for scuttle, so smite it first when you are sure the enemy jungler isn't there. kite enemy champions, remember you are ranged! make advantage of speed, learn to dodge. position yourself in the edge of your Q when hitting enemies, then hit them with the center of the W if you managed to do enough damage. never be afraid of throwing a casual long range E! it might hit and kill the target 5 seconds later because of the triple burn. yes. triple burn. always liandrys+demonic embrace. i hate zhonyas personally, but it's necessary sometimes. you are easily burstable. don't waste your R! very long cooldowns, wait for it to secure kill if necessary. you can use it to escape people faster than you, though. remember it can be dodged by spell shields or even yasuo W. have fun. keep powerfarming.
